premises.text: Early circuit-board prototyping via overseas fabs is slow, costly iteration that blocks hardware development
premises.evidence_span: Most designers outsource fabrication to facilities in China, pay a couple hundred dollars, and wait two weeks for delivery

premises.text: A desktop printer uses silver nanoparticle ink to create circuit traces, including multi-layer boards, in about an hour
premises.evidence_span: a printer that can create a circuit board in the time it takes to go get lunch

premises.text: The same printer can dispense solder paste and bake boards to populate prototypes after design
premises.evidence_span: it'll even dispense solder paste and bake the board for you

premises.text: Customers buy the printer via pre-order and purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates online
premises.evidence_span: our customers will be able to purchase replacement ink cartridges and substrates directly through our website

premises.text: Hardware developers from large tech, startups, academia, and hobbyists need faster in-house electronics prototyping
premises.evidence_span: We've talked to engineers from large tech companies, hardware startups, and the academic and hobbyist community

domains.name: slow PCB prototype pain and users

value.text: Hardware teams get custom circuits in minutes instead of weeks, faster and cheaper toward manufacturing
value.evidence_span: We're not trying to replace mass manufacturing, just help people get there faster and save huge costs along the way

causal_links.evidence_span: hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics
the choice between lead times of two weeks or just 60 minutes is an easy one to make

notes: China wait-loop and toxic hobby etching folded as one prototyping-pain set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Multi-layer insulating sandwich kept inside the silver-ink print mechanism; solder-paste/bake split as separately emphasized post-prototype module (§4.1.7 tie-break). Shenzhen accelerator stay excluded as bio/traction. Anti-template: demand, printer product, and consumables GTM separately revisable.
